Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the candid context on ingestion volumes, latency targets, and compliance constraints for each region. Quick recap and a concrete next step so we can lock a technical deep-dive/demo that works across your teams in US / EU / APAC.

Recap (top-lines):

- Stakeholders: Alex (product/ops, Acme), Sophie (security/compliance, Globex), Kenji (platform, Zenith).
- Next meeting: 60–90m technical deep-dive + live demo (solutions engineer + SRE).

To make scheduling smoother across time zones, we typically propose a rotating weekly cadence so no single region is always outside core hours. Here are two scheduling patterns we like:

Option A — 3-week rotation (recommended)
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue / Wed 10:00–11:30 PT (US west morning)
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Wed / Thu 15:00–16:30 CET (EU afternoon)
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Thu / Fri 10:00–11:30 JST (APAC morning)

Option B — Bi-weekly split (less frequent rotation)
- Week 1: US & EU overlap window (14:00–15:00 UTC)
- Week 2: APAC-focused (01:00–03:00 UTC / 10:00–12:00 JST)

Can you please indicate which option you prefer (A or B), and if Option A works, which of these near-term slots is best for your teams? If none of these fit, share 2–3 times that do and I'll send invites.

Near-term candidate dates (Option A examples):
- Tue Mar 29, 2027 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 GMT
- Wed Mar 30, 2027 — 15:00 CET / 10:00 PT / 19:00 JST
- Thu Apr 1, 2027 — 10:00 JST / 02:00 UTC / 19:00 PT (if APAC preference)

Attachments: I'm attaching a draft rotating_demo_schedule.xlsx with timezone conversions and a short Demo-Agenda.pdf. I've also attached a SOW-draft.docx that legal asked to have visibility on early.

I've cc'd Marissa (CS lead) and will include our Solutions Engineer Aditya for the technical session once we lock the slot.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.
